title: The Heiress He Threw Away: Her Revenge Era
description: He discarded her like garbage, completely clueless that she was actually the secret heir to a global empire. Three years later, she walks back into his world—not to beg for his love, but to ruin his life. Get ready for cold-blooded revenge, high-society drama, and a glow-up that will leave him on his knees.
